correctness.rationale: The proof conditions richness increments on the latent frequencies, evaluates the resulting discovery/entropy mixed moment from explicit beta integrals, and simplifies it to a positive digamma increment. Exact telescoping and summation by parts give both closed covariance forms. The saturation and scaled-correlation limits then follow from the trigamma tail, exact Dirichlet-process cluster-count variance, and standard entropy variance.

value.rationale: Observed richness and latent Shannon entropy are canonical, differently weighted diversity summaries. The exact covariance calibrates their redundancy under the foundational Dirichlet-process model. The finite saturation ceiling despite logarithmically diverging richness variance, and the resulting 1/sqrt(log n) correlation decay, give a structural account of diminishing entropy information in continued rare-species discovery.
